name: Azure Cosmos DB
line: Run managed NoSQL databases with vector search and multiple APIs.

sql.math: Request units (RUs) depend on item size, indexing, query work and consistency. The workload does not give these, so no total can be set.
730 hours × $0.032 an hour for the minimum of 400 RU/s (request units per second), plus 1 GB of storage at $0.25 per GB a month. Extras and tax are not included.
